purpose: Agroecological decision-support scaffolding, not an operational planting forecast

zones.label: Sahel savanna
cautions: Rain-fed sowing requires confirmed local onset and soil moisture

zones.label: Derived savanna
cautions: Local site conditions and irrigation matter

zones.label: Humid forest
cautions: Avoid treating rainfall as irrigation guarantee

zones.label: Coastal and swamp environments
cautions: Salinity and flooding can make sites unsuitable
Raised beds and drainage may be required

zones.label: Highland microclimates
cautions: Avoid applying lowland crop calendars unchanged

region_lookup_policy: Do not infer zone from state alone; request LGA or user-selected zone and validate against authoritative NAERLS data. Never request exact home address.
verification: Zone labels are broad working categories; precise LGA boundary mapping and crop calendars not yet ingested.
